0x00056C:
A giant hibernation facility of Project Ark, the <EOT Special Council>'s species preservation plan, built underground in Kenya, Africa. It is run by Magus, an autonomous supercomputer by Dr. Sophia Nate. Thousands were to sleep through the Aerogater invasion, but the <DC War> halted construction.
After the war, DC remnants used it as a base until the Kurogane's crew wrecked it; it is now under a Federation research institute. A twin 'Moon Cradle' exists on the Moon.
0x000938: Anti-alien mobile weapons evolved from fighters. The <Tesla Drive>, splitting gravitational and inertial mass, lets them outfly any fighter. The DC's mainstay; <Isurugi Heavy Ind.> still builds them.
0x000B4E: Short for 'Identification Friend Foe' - a device that tells friend from foe.
0x000BEE:
An isolated South Pacific island near the Marquesas where Meteor 3 fell in New Era 179. The <EOTI Organization> based itself there to study it; its <EOT> and anti-alien weapons research became the <DC>'s power base.
Heavily fortified for <EOT> secrecy with air-centered defenses, it was largely destroyed in the <L5 Campaign>, then rebuilt by the GS as its base, 'Grand Christmas.'
0x000F14:
Grotesque beings that appeared in the Earth Sphere in New Era 187-188. Their main force, the Einst series, were enigmatic living weapons that at first waged inexplicable localized battles. Only the high-ranking Einst Regisseur and a girl named Alfimi showed clear will; their society resembled bees or ants.
The Einst long existed in another dimension (Einst space), watching the real world's intelligent life. To silence endlessly warring humanity and create a new intelligent species, they tried to join Einst space to the real world and invade it.
They fought the Hagane, Kurogane, and Hiryu Custom repeatedly. In the final battle Neu Regisseur fused with the White Star into the colossal Stern Neu Regisseur but fell; the remaining Einst then vanished.
0x0014FD: A measure of the <Telekinesis Alpha Pulse> and of <T-LINK System> aptitude. Focused people score high; past a set value, one has telekinesis.
0x00168F: Short for Extra Over Technology - alien super-technology from 'Meteor 3,' the meteorite that fell on Aidoneus Island. Analyzed by the <EOTI Organization> under Dr. Bian Zoldark, it revolutionized military technology under <EOT Special Council> control.
0x0018E9: Extra Over Technology Inquiry Organization. Founded in New Era 180 to analyze the <EOT> in 'Meteor 3,' the meteorite that fell on Aidoneus Island. Brilliant scientists gathered worldwide under Bian Zoldark, the genius of his age. It became the parent body of the <DC>, whose scientists continued developing weapons and systems.
0x001BA1: A high-level Federation body handling secrets on Meteor 3 and the Aerogaters: 13 core members of the Federation Security Council, ranking above the <EOTI Organization>. Chaired by Karl Stresemann. Knowing the Aerogaters' might from Meteor 3 and <EOT> studies, it deemed Bian's resistance stance dangerous and obstructed him - one factor in the <DC> revolt. All members died in the L5 Campaign, ending it.
0x001F14: fA leader in shipbuilding, power plants and aircraft. While supplying Federation fighters like the F-32 Schwert, it dealt with the <EOTI Organization> and secretly mass-produced the Lion series in the <DC War>. The series became the Federation mainstay after the <L5 Campaign>, so its DC ties went unpunished to secure production.
0x0021F6: Aliens from another star system who had long audited Earth's civilization. Judging humanity's fighting spirit a threat to galactic order, they schemed to control the Earth Sphere. The name 'Inspectors,' coined offhand by their commander Vigagi against the Hiryu Custom, became Earth's codename for them. Invading in New Era 187, their blitz seized the <White Star>, the Moon, and much of North America. Caught between 'Operation Plantagenet' and the mass <Einst> outbreak, they were driven off Earth, then beaten at the White Star. With supreme commander Wendolo dead they were destroyed - though some call them a mere advance force.
0x00276D: The upheaval caused by the Inspectors in New Era 187-188. Aliens auditing Earth's civilization, they judged humanity's insatiable fighting spirit a threat to galactic order and schemed to control the Earth Sphere. Invading in 187, they blitzed the Moon and North America, but the mass Einst outbreak forced them off Earth, and the Kurogane and Hiryu Custom annihilated them.
0x002A98: %A device fitted to certain <T-LINK System>-equipped machines. Officially a T-LINK auxiliary, it activates forcibly under set conditions, taking over telekinetic devices, machine control, fire control and output. It briefly exceeds catalog specs while badly straining pilot and machine. Called 'a system for inducing hysterical strength,' its details are known only to a few in the <SRX Project>. One theory credits ex-project head Ingram Prisken, an Aerogater agent; its black-boxed core defies even T-LINK developer Dr. Kenzou Kobayashi.
0x002F6B: 'Aerogaters' is Earth's codename for the force that struck the Earth Sphere from Neviim, an automated planet that appeared at L5, using insectoid mobile weapons like the Megillot. They schemed to exploit humanity's combat ability, but lost in Operation SRW, the L5 Campaign's finale. They proved to be humans conditioned by an unknown party - a fact kept strictly secret.
0x0032C5: AMN: Armored Module Network, a system that rapidly relays combat data between <Armored Module>s and shares it across units. The former <EOTI Organization> and <DC> pursued it, but slow mutual data exchange kept it from adoption.
0x0034D6: Develops assault-type humanoid mobile weapons. Twin pillar to the <SRX Project>, it builds machines largely forgoing <EOT>, per head Dr. Marion Radom. Once aimed at the next Federation mainline unit, it now makes custom machines for aces.
0x0036B6: A plan to develop special humanoid weapons for anti-alien combat. R-Series units apply <EOT> extensively.
0x003787: One type of 'barrier' - defenses that nullify attacks by projecting non-physical energy: EM waves, gravity, telekinesis, photons. Fields are matched to the attack, working by neutralization, diffusion, or distortion. Airborne matter can crystallize on the surface, 'shattering' when it fails.
0x003A04: Short for Mass Amplitude Preemptivestrike Weapon: a weapon for wide-area first strikes. By area of effect they divide into straight-line, circular, and impact-scatter types. Also called 'map weapons.'
0x003B88: Conflict the Aerogaters caused after the <DC> War in New Era 187. From Neviim (codename: White Star), an automated planetoid that appeared at L5, they raided the Earth Sphere with insectoid mobile weapons like the Megillot. Impressed by human combat skill, they schemed to make humans their own soldiers, but lost the final battle, Operation SRW. They proved to be humans mentally conditioned by an unknown party - a strict secret.
0x003F05:
The first fully sealed space colony (NE 075). Seat of the Colony Integrated Government. Also HQ of the <Colony Integ. Army>. Colony history through the 180s was harsh: civil strife in 076 after the first emigrants' adaptation surgery failed; a terrorist bid for autonomy in 157 (the Nozomi Incident); a bulkhead bombing in 172 (the Hope Incident); and a BC-weapon attack in 184 (the Elpis Incident).
From the early 160s the NID4 movement sought self-rule peacefully. Its leader, Brian Midcrid, won over Earth's public, achieved independence in 184, and became first president; the Federation space forces there became the <Colony Integ. Army> under Maier.
The ten colonies, all at L4, are No. 1 Elpis, No. 2 Nozomi, No. 3 Hoffnung, No. 4 Wish, No. 5 Espoir, No. 6 Hope, No. 7 Space, No. 8 Esperanza, No. 9 Speranza, and No. 10 Nadezhda.
0x004659: A man-machine interface built by Egret Feff, a scientist at the <Earth Cradle>, with Adler's backing. It direct-links pilot and machine for smoother control, and can also act on the pilot, forcibly boosting aggression and reflexes. Pilots cannot yet endure long use without enhancement.
0x004925:
Formed in New Era 184, when ten space colonies united as a nation, from the Earth Federation space forces stationed there. Nominally separate, it is effectively under Federation Army control, which some resent. Its demanding space combat role makes its personnel highly skilled.
In late New Era 186 it declared war on the Federation alongside the DC. Holding most spaceborne forces, it quickly seized space, then supported DC ground operations. After commander Maier V. Branstein fell it surrendered - in truth to prepare for the alien war - and many units joined 'Operation SRW,' the L5 Campaign's final operation.
Postwar its leaders were replaced and its name became a formality, but it still forms most of Earth's space forces.
0x004EEB: A parallel-world group, via the transfer device 'System XN.' Once that world's Federation special-ops unit, after the <L5 Campaign> they backed the DC remnants' uprising to perfect System XN and prolong war via mass-produced units and 'W Series' androids, but fell to the Hagane and Hiryu Custom.
0x005160:
Shura Gods are the weapons of the Shura, powered by their handlers' life energy. Ranks are 'Retsu,' 'Gou,' and 'Chou' class; the lowest, Retsu, can be piloted by any Shura with enough fighting spirit and skill.
Gou- and Chou-class machines choose their riders: becoming a handler demands strength, trials, and rites, and once chosen, no other can pilot it until that handler dies. Said to hold wills of their own, they admit only those they accept - an unqualified rider has their spirit drained and dies. Gou class and above used lost technology today's Shura cannot reproduce, so they are few; some have served for centuries, and several lie sealed, awaiting handlers.
A Gou-class handler holds respect and authority among the Shura, and piloting a Chou-class machine is required to become a Shura general. Retsu-class units are copies of surviving Gou-class machines - far weaker, but mass-producible.
0x0058A1: A conflict waged by the 'Shura,' warriors of the otherworld Shura Realm. With their world nearing ruin, Alkaid, king of Ra, led them aboard 'Tenku Majo' (codename: Swordian), a dimension-crossing sword-shaped fortress, seeking a new home. Arriving after the <Inspector Incident>, they invaded with the <Shura God> mobile weapons. Cities fell until the Hagane and Hiryu Custom raided the fortress in 'Operation Overgate,' beating Alkaid with Folka Albark and other Shura who sided with Earth. The survivors then left aboard it.
0x005D26:
A humanoid-weapon pilot training institution once in the Federation Army, founded alongside the <Aggressors>. It first retrained conventional pilots for machines like the <Personal Trooper>, but its aim changed once Adler Koch took charge.
Rather than convert veterans, Adler sought pilots raised from the start for humanoid weapons. He secretly gathered orphans with superior reflexes and dynamic vision, had Dr. Agilla Setme alter their memories, and through conditioning, drugs, and training tried to swiftly create humans specialized in piloting and combat: the 'Boosted Children.' They were sorted into metal-named classes - Aurum (gold), Argent (silver), Bronzo (bronze), Hierro (iron), Latooni (brass) - and adjusted for various roles.
Only a handful excelled. The inhumane program and poor results became a scandal and the School was dissolved, but the Boosted Children's training continued under the <DC>.
0x0064BD: The Earth Federation's international military, built from the old-era UN Special Forces. It alone is unified globally, though each regional army keeps traits of the national forces it grew from.
0x00668B: A global political body grown from a provisional UN organ amid the chaos after the AD 2012 meteor disaster ('Double Impact'). Though it stands above nations as an international authority, it never unified all governance, and old regional conflicts carried over.
0x0068B8:
Semi-organic weapons ancient China created to fight the demons called the 'Hundred Evils.' They have minds of their own, but show true power only under a telekinetic pilot they accept; ordinary pilots pay in life force.
Ranks include the 'Four Spirits,' 'Four Gods,' and 'Four Perils'; machines besides RyuKoOh and KoRyuOh likely exist.
0x006BD2: A barrier projected from the Tower of Harmony over all <La Gias>, supplying mana worldwide and limiting great magic.
0x006D60:
Tactical Cybernetics OS: the operating system of <Personal Trooper>s and other humanoid weapons. When the pilot orders an action like 'strike the enemy,' its AI computes both machines' positions and picks the most efficient motion from stored pattern data.
The pilot is freed from manual control: minimal input focused on judgment, while the machine moves on its own. Pilots can tune motion data priority to their habits.
0x0071E3: An uprising by the <DC> from late New Era 186 into 187. It seized bases across the Earth Sphere in a blitz using <Armored Module>s, but leader Bian Zoldark died in the Hagane's raid on Aidoneus Island; the DC fell into chaos and lost.
0x0073E7:
A telekinesis sensing and amplification device by Dr. Kenzo Kobayashi of the <SRX Project>. It extracts 'T-Alpha Pulses,' deep brainwaves governing thought, to control objects' motion and assist in piloting mobile weapons. It can also generate a Telekinetic Field, usable as a barrier or a ram. Amplified thought widens the user's sixth-sense-like perception, aiding enemy detection.
The system depends on the user's mental state, though, and excessive linkage strains the brain. Those whose T-Alpha Pulses exceed a set level are called 'Psychodrivers.'
0x007831:
A military organization founded from the <EOTI Organization> by Dr. Bian Zoldark, who foresaw an alien invasion. Its aim: a strong military regime in the Earth Sphere to oppose the invaders. It drew Federation soldiers, anti-Federation activists, and liberation fighters; the <Colony Integ. Army> cooperated too.
In late New Era 186 it rose against the <Earth Fed Gov't>, seizing bases across the Earth Sphere in a blitz using <Armored Module>s. But Bian and Maier V. Branstein's plan was double-edged: by playing the 'enemy' they meant to rouse humanity to fight, yet a long civil war risked draining Earth's strength. They sought a quick end while sparing Federation forces, and Bian would entrust the Earth Sphere's future to any strong enough to defeat him.
That contradiction invited defeat and emboldened those exploiting the DC. He died in the Hagane's raid on DC HQ; the leaderless DC fell apart and lost to the Federation.
0x008003: A high-efficiency reaction thruster from the <Tesla Leicht Institute>. Altering gravitational and inertial mass separately, it drives objects efficiently - gravity control easing flight in air and space, though early units fit only warships. Meteor 3's <EOT> advanced the physics, shrinking it; from the <DC>'s Armored Modules on, 20m units could mount it.
0x0083BF: An over-technology research institute in Colorado, founded in New Era 171 by Bian Zoldark. Alumni include robotics authorities Jonathan Kazahara and Erik Wan. Though most members left for the <EOTI Organization>, it continues <EOT> research, <Tesla Drive> improvements, and Grungust-series development. Named for Nikola Tesla and Wilhelm Reich; Kazahara now directs it.
0x0086D2: A deep brainwave governing thought, proposed by Dr. Kenzo Kobayashi. Gauges Psychodriver aptitude.
0x0087BB: A squad formed to research combat techniques and motion data for humanoid mobile weapons. The basic motion data in the <TC-OS> of current Personal Troopers came from their trials. Its six elites: captain Kar-Wai Lau, Kai Kitamura, Tempest Hawker, Sanger Zonvolt, Elzam V. Branstein, and Gilliam Yeager. Disbanded after an incident in New Era 184, its colorful members and feats made it semi-legendary in the Federation Army. It re-formed after the <L5 Campaign>, with Kai Kitamura as captain.
0x008BA4: Special humanoid weapons, popularly 'Super Robots': mostly 40m-plus units with unique power sources.
0x008C88: A substance discovered in Meteor 3, absent from the Solar System and found sealed in clearly artificial containers. Each piece is a rice-grain-sized metal holding enormous energy. Six existed; the <EOTI Organization> analyzed them, and some reached the Federation Army through deals involving Major Ingram Prisken of the SRX Project. The Tronium Engine extracts this virtually inexhaustible energy as motive power; its conversion per unit time is immeasurable. Since Earth-level materials cannot withstand the output, limiters are installed, and raising output also speeds energy generation, making control extremely difficult.
0x00919B: A revolt in New Era 186 at the Federation Army's Coatsland Base, Antarctica. The base was unveiling the Shirogane, first Space Noah-class carrier, and the Granzon, a humanoid mobile weapon from the <EOTI Organization> - camouflage for secret talks with extraterrestrials, the 'Guests.' The terms amounted to near-total capitulation, angering many who knew. During the talks Dr. Shu Shirakawa, Granzon developer and test pilot, suddenly attacked the Guests' craft, then the Federation forces, wrecking the base. Talks collapsed, and the <DC> soon rose up, triggering the wars that followed (the <DC War>, <L5 Campaign>, and <Inspector Incident>). As the Guests arrived in an <Aerogaters> ship, many equated the two; since the <Inspector Incident> the prevailing view is that the ship was a decoy and the Guests are a force tied to the <Inspectors>.
0x0098EE: A military organization formed after the <L5 Campaign> by Van Vat Tran, uniting <DC> remnants and anti-Federationists with <Shadow Mirror> aid. It rose in New Era 187 to unify the Earth Sphere, but its true foes were the aliens, and the Inspectors' arrival brought a truce. In the North America recapture Van died to a Shadow Mirror plot; remnants fight on as guerrillas.
0x009C0D: Humanoid mobile weapons developed to counter the articulated weapons the Aerogaters were thought to field. The first, the <Mao Industries> PTX-001 Gespenst, rolled out in New Era 180. They swap weapons via manipulators and move nimbly on legs or hover. Under the <TC-OS>, minimal input lets the machine act out the pilot's intent.
0x009FAE: Pilots of humanoid mobile weapons raised at the <School>. Kinless children with keen reflexes and dynamic vision got mind control, drugs and harsh training. Memories were erased; severe <Limacon> broke many minds. Arado, Seolla, and Latooni are among the few survivors.
0x00A212: Human life energy, like aura or ki. It cloaks the body, swelling with emotion. <La Gias> natives vary less than surfacers.
0x00A339: An interstellar flight program using mid-sized ships, begun under the <DC>. It builds starships and trains pilots; after the DC fell it continued under the Federation, backed by <Isurugi Heavy Ind.>. "TD" means "<Tesla Drive>" and "Terrestrial Dream."
0x00A571:
A spherical space fortress used by the <Aerogaters> as their base in the <L5 Campaign>. Formally the "Automated Planet Neviim"; "White Star" was Earth's codename. With mobile weapon plants, a spaceport, a 1G housing block, and farms, it is virtually a mobile colony; one unproven theory says it was to carry warlike humans to the Aerogater homeworld.
Crippled by the Operation SRW allied fleet's assault, it passed to Federation control. In New Era 187 the invading <Inspectors> seized it as their base. It later fused with Neue Regisseur, leader of the <Einst>, becoming the giant weapon Stern Regisseur, and vanished after a fierce battle with the Kurogane and Hiryu Custom.
0x00AAFB: XA heavy machinery maker Tin Mao founded in New Era 176 with Yuan Meilun in the lunar city Celevis. It first built lunar work machines but now mainly makes Personal Troopers. President: Tin's daughter Ring Mao.
0x00ACCF: Self-repairing, self-evolving metal cells made by Dr. Egret Feff. They invade matter, rewriting its composition to strengthen and control it. Predating the <DC War>, they were boosted by a Zfylud Crystal sample from <Aerogaters> weapons. In the <Inspector Incident> the <Neue DC> machines Thrudgelmir and Bergelmir used them to regenerate.
0x00B02D: Humanoid weapons of <La Gias>. Once meaning only Langran's sixteen machines, the term now covers all such units.
0x00B16C: I<Elemental> machines bound to high spirits that choose their own operators, built by Langran to guard all <La Gias>. Four exist: Wind, Flame, Water, Earth.
0x00B2E8: A meteorite that fell in New Era 179 on Aidoneus Island in the South Pacific. <EOTI Organization> studies suggest the Aerogaters sent it deliberately: it appeared suddenly at L5, decelerated on its own before impact, and held <EOT> sealed inside, packaged for study. Named after 'Meteor 1' and 'Meteor 2,' Old Era meteorites that struck New York and Moscow and gravely set back Earth's civilization.
0x00B62C: Short for 'Moon Orbital Search System.' An automated early-warning net of unmanned probes across a sphere bounded by the Moon's orbit. Superior to the Satellite Link System, it was built by the Colony Integration Army before the DC War; the Federation Army now runs it.
0x00B86B: A world inside the Earth. Shaped like a hollow sphere's interior, yet phase-shifted rather than literally underground. The name means 'the true land.'
0x00B9BD: Short for 'Re-Mind Control': per-mission memory adjustment and mental control of subjects under memory manipulation, like the <Boosted Children>. Heavy rewriting risks mental collapse, so data is changed gradually. <Boosted Children> keyed by emotions - love, friendship, hostility, grudges - easily exceed their specs.
0x00BCA6: The ReEOTH PLAN. ReEOTH ('Laios') stands for 'Reliable Extra Over Technological Hybrid' - alien technology made highly dependable. It reworks the unstable <EOT>, raising reliability and stability with Earth's latest technology. Beyond upgrading existing EOT-equipped machines, it aims to bring ReEOTH into R-Series successors and future mass-production units.
0x00BF97: Name of the quantum computer in Solatis Temple.
0x00C010: A homogenized force field that warps kinetic energy at its edge, dispersing it as boundary tension. EM waves lose their waveform, nullifying beams and rounds alike.
